Type: tufted upholstered bench
Use: seating at the foot of a bed, extra seating; bedroom, living room, entryway
Style: glam, contemporary, art deco
Materials: tufted fabric cushion, gold-finish metal frame
Colors: light warm beige, brushed gold
Shape: long rectangular padded seat with button tufting, open square-tube metal frame with six legs and low stretchers, backless, long and light
Feel: elegant, airy, polished
Goes with: cream or blush textiles, marble, brass accents; glam or modern bedrooms

product.name: Amazon Brand – Rivet Glam Tufted Seat Upholstered Bench with Gold Legs , 58"L, Gold Finish
product.description: This simple upholstered bench can be played up or down, depending on your taste. The gold finish is handsome but not too shiny. Use it at the foot of your bed or anywhere else you'd like to add a touch of glam. 58"L X 18"W X 19"D Metal with gold finish, polyester fabric Modern and simple yet distinctive design Perfect as a comfortable bench or a place to lay an extra blanket Assemble in 15-30 minutes. Wipe with soft dry cloth. Free returns for 30 days. 1-year warranty.
